correctness.rationale: Even-degree interior constraints force complete selected paths; terminal parity equals even number of selected paths. An exact Bernoulli product parity projection gives all subset marginals and strict prefactor factorization. Conditional odds for every fixed other measured configuration prove iff mutual independence, including the all-path case. All hypotheses are open edge parameter intervals. Direct edge-level independent exact-rational enumeration passed 2,102 checks on 9 finite examples; finite checks are not the infinite-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Weighted theta/multipath networks already play a central published role in counterexamples to FKG/monotonicity for even subgraphs, so their correlation structure is mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary slice. The exact all-m covariance sign classification across heterogeneous edge weights, parity-of-branch-count reversal, and iff balanced-unobserved-branch mutual-independence mechanism isolate previously unstated interpretable dependence boundaries beyond individual partition-sum calculations. Does not assert a general percolation theorem.
